# Guided Meditation: Transmuting Power of the Spiritual Eye

### Brother Chidananda • Self-Realization Fellowship

Greetings and blessings. Brother Chidananda leads us in a sacred guided meditation to awaken and focus our energy at the Christ center—the point between the eyebrows, known as the spiritual eye. This is the gateway to the infinite light and transmuting power of Spirit.

### The Gateway to Cosmic Light

When we concentrate our attention at the spiritual eye, we align with the single eye mentioned in the scriptures: *"If thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light."* This single eye is the portal through which our consciousness expands to discover cosmic peace.

### Transmuting Darkness and Habitude

All negative thoughts and past karmic impressions are dissolved when we lift them into the spiritual eye. Feel that any sorrow, fear, or anxiety is being consumed in the holy white-and-golden light of the forehead.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Fix Your Gaze:** Concentrate at the Christ center between the eyebrows during your prayers and meditation, without straining your eyes.
* **Refuse Shadows:** When negative thoughts arise during the day, look upward and imagine them being incinerated in the light.
* **Calm Breathing:** Practice slow, deep breaths, feeling your consciousness rise with each inhalation.
* **Sadhana Routine:** Dedicate at least 15 minutes of uninterrupted silence to this practice every night.

May you stay beautifully attuned. Jai Guru!
